idea: I write a fortnightly tea-tasting newsletter for about 300 subscribers. I draft in plain text and want a small tool that keeps my subscriber list, lets people join or leave via a link, and sends the issue when I hit go. That is genuinely all I want it to do.

problem: I manage the list by hand in a spreadsheet and pasting 300 addresses into BCC is error-prone; I have leaked addresses into the To field once already.
user: Only me sending; subscribers just receive email and click join or leave links.
workflow: People subscribe through a link; every issue I paste my draft in, preview, and send; unsubscribes take effect immediately without my involvement.
success: An issue goes out in under five minutes of my time with zero address leaks, and unsubscribes never need me.
non-goals: No analytics, no templates, no scheduling, no paid tiers — I actively do not want them.
